claims.statement: task-closeout writes only under .agents/sessions/<session-folder>/ and never creates or edits .agents/AGENTS.md, openwiki/**, .agents/playbooks/**, .agents/skills/**, or openspec/ for in-flight changes; proposed durable or skill changes are captured as prose inside the bundle for learning-distill to apply.
Each bundle directory must contain exactly five files with fixed roles: summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt, and validation.txt.

summary.json contractual minimum is a required stable string task_id as canonical task/session identifier; optional repo_id, optional openspec_change when an OpenSpec change was worked, optional prior_session, optional agent/agent_session_id, git metadata (branch, head_commit, workspace_root), timestamps and distillation flags distilled/distillation_status; include openspec_change when applicable and do not modify specs during closeout.
Canonical identity is summary.json task_id; the folder name YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic is only a sortable storage label, one bundle per folder, never used to infer identity.

When a session worked on an OpenSpec change, summary.json records that change name in openspec_change per closeout-change-linking; when no change was involved the field is absent or null and closeout succeeds; closeout leaves openspec/ untouched for in-flight changes and notes pending spec updates in learning-candidate.md for /opsx:archive time.

summary.json may contain an optional prior_session path pointer to an earlier bundle directory to chain related closeouts without reopening or merging earlier packets, which stay append-only after closeout.

Optional provenance fields agent and agent_session_id are recorded independently whenever the active tool supplies them, mirrored as Agent and Agent Session ID sections in active-task.md, and never invented or looked up outside the tool's session history.

changed-files.txt derivation falls back when git status is clean: use git log -1 --name-only for latest commit, widen to git log -N --name-only or git diff --name-only <base>..HEAD to match task scope so evidence is accurate after commits.

validation.txt records checks run and outcomes as machine-checkable evidence, mirrored in active-task.md Commands Run and Validation sections, while learning-candidate.md separates what failed, what worked, and reusable pattern with Confidence.

Skill initialization is idempotent per repo: resolve repo root, ensure .agents/sessions/ exists, copy bootstrap/sessions/README.md if missing, ensure .agents/.gitignore contains sessions/* and !sessions/README.md merging without removing unrelated rules or replicate as .agents/sessions/* and !.agents/sessions/README.md in root gitignore when .agents/.gitignore is not tracked; it does not create durable AGENTS.md, playbooks, or wiki content.

After closeout the bundle is immutable except for status/distillation-related fields in summary.json (distilled, distillation_status, status) that a later tool may update; all other files remain frozen.

Per-task folders under .agents/sessions/ are gitignored via sessions/* + !sessions/README.md (only README.md tracked), so discovery during distillation must use ignore-blind methods such as filesystem listing ls/find or ripgrep --no-ignore-vcs/--no-ignore and then filter by summary.json task_id/distilled/status not folder name.

Proposed task-start sequencing is strict: task-start owns creation by seeding summary.json with task_id, created_at, status in_progress and optional openspec_change/repo_id/agent, task-closeout owns finalization by detecting the seeded summary.json and preserving task_id and openspec_change while appending completed_at, final status, git metadata and distillation flags plus the remaining bundle files, learning-distill consumes only after closeout marks ready with no overlapping writers and summary.json as single source of truth; when invoked without a prior task-start closeout retains its generation fallback and must preserve and pass through openspec_change and distillation flags.
